channel.title: Flog It!

Antiques experts Philip Serrell and Nick Davies get to meet people from all over Merseyside who have brought in their antiques and collectibles to receive a valuation. Paul gets special permission to go behind the scenes with National Museums Liverpool to find out how they preserve the millions of often priceless objects that are in their care at the Conservation Studios in the city centre.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: The Guns of Navarone
channel.desc: A small group of commandos, led by Captain Keith Mallory, are assigned to attack and destroy the eponymous guns - installed on the side of a mountain - that are preventing allied ships from rescuing 2,000 trapped British soldiers. Unable to attack by air or sea, the crack team is sent in, but it seems there is a turncoat amongst them.

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.name: BBC Two NL

channel.desc: A French couple move to a Galician town in search of a closer relationship with nature. However, a conflict with their neighbours, the Anta brothers, causes tensions to grow until the situation reaches a point of no return.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Saving Lives at Sea
channel.desc: On the Northumberland coast, a 999 call comes in from a woman whose husband is drifting out to sea on a paddleboard; it's a race against time for the Seahouses crew to find him.

channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: DIY SOS
channel.desc: In Southampton, the team comes to the aid of Ahmed and Rifat, a profoundly deaf couple whose dream home became a nightmare after a rogue builder abandoned the project. With three young children, no savings left and living on a building site, they need help to complete their home and make it work for their family's needs. Nick and the team call on the local community to transform both the house and the family's future.

Reinstating the old Caledonian pine forests is the first of his plans. He then wants to release long lost animals, starting with moose and wild boar, and eventually predators such as brown bears, lynx and wolves.

Paul also fulfils a lifetime's dream when he runs away to Gloucester-based circus Giffords.

channel.desc: Covering the latest news on the economy, society, sport and culture, with insightful analysis and expert commentary.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: The Journal Editorial Report
channel.desc: Wall Street Journal editor Paul Gigot serves as moderator on this weekly show that features newsmaker interviews and panel discussions with other Journal staffers. Interview topics include guests' writings and current events. Panel discussions with the publication's writers and editors revolve around political, economic and cultural issues that people are talking about that week. Each half-hour episode ends with panelists discussing the best and worst stories in the news the previous week.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: Fox Report With Jon Scott
channel.desc: The latest headlines, news and analysis.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: The Big Weekend Show
channel.desc: Rotating panelists discuss the big news of the day and react to the top stories.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: Life, Liberty & Levin
channel.desc: Mark Levin hosts FOX News Channel's "Life, Liberty and Levin." The program aims to explore the fundamental values and principles of American society, politics, culture, and current events and the impact that these things have on the nation's future and the everyday lives of the citizens. Levin also hosts "The Mark Levin Show," and prior to joining FOX, he served as an adviser to some of President Ronald Reagan's cabinet members.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: My View With Lara Trump
channel.desc: Presenting in-depth analysis of the issues and stories that matter most to Americans while offering context and solutions to help bring the country together.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Live: FOX News Saturday Night With Jimmy Failla
channel.desc: Host Jimmy Failla welcomes guests to give a humorous perspective on the stories America is talking about and everyday issues.

channel.name: Fox News US
channel.title: Gutfeld!
channel.desc: Greg Gutfeld looks at the news of the day through a satiric lens fused with pop culture and features his takes on the day's headlines.

channel.desc: Mark Levin hosts FOX News Channel's "Life, Liberty and Levin." The program aims to explore the fundamental values and principles of American society, politics, culture, and current events and the impact that these things have on the nation's future and the everyday lives of the citizens. Levin also hosts "The Mark Levin Show," and prior to joining FOX, he served as an adviser to some of President Ronald Reagan's cabinet members.

channel.desc: Danny Noonan (Michael O'Keefe), a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member (Ted Knight). Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb (Chevy Chase).

channel.name: PopTV US
channel.title: City Slickers
channel.desc: Every year, three friends take a vacation away from their wives. This year, henpecked Phil (Daniel Stern), newly married Ed (Bruno Kirby), and Mitch (Billy Crystal) -- terrified of his midlife crisis -- decide to reignite their masculinity by taking a supervised cattle drive across the Southwest. Under the supervision of gruff cowboy Curly (Jack Palance), the men set out on a journey that turns unexpectedly dangerous. The three men bond along the way to conquering their fear of aging.
